status.label: Reviewing findings
status.detail: The saved automated review arrived on the unchanged exact mirror head as a limited pass after its full agentic review timed out. All review, inline-comment and thread pages were exhausted: three comments were grounded, and two optional or unsupported concerns were answered and resolved without source changes. Only the negative-geometry concern remains unresolved. Source tracing identifies reachable negative arm lengths near monitor edges in the newly changed fixed-length mode; similar full-length behavior predates this change. The actual Composition rendering impact is not yet verified. A private fixed-mode-only candidate and minimal-range, raw-line-ending checks are prepared, but no candidate was applied, compiled or run. Next steps are native tests of the production geometry helper and an isolated two-monitor UI check of edge and seam rendering. The review is not converged and no author-facing proposal or clean result is available.

next_action: Resume the saved review stage in the next dashboard update.
